description: This file defines the StoreList class, which implements an entity operation for storing a list of GenericValue entities within the OFBiz mini-language framework. It includes validation, execution logic for storing entities, and a factory class for creating instances.

classes.name: StoreList
classes.description: Implements the <store-list> element, responsible for storing a list of entity values into the database.

classes.name: StoreListFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating StoreList instances.

methods.name: StoreList
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the StoreList with XML element attributes and performs validation.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the store operation by retrieving the list of entities and storing them via the delegator.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the StoreList object.
